exposure: mode of delivery (planned vs emergency caesarean)
women with false positive PAS diagnosis
women with different grades of PAS
cohort: 356 women who underwent caesarean delivery for suspected placenta accreta spectrum at 1 of 15 referral centres between 2008 and 2019
finding: Emergency caesarean delivery was not associated with increased blood loss, transfusion rates or overall maternal morbidity in women with suspected PAS treated at specialist centres, but was associated with increased rate of admission to intensive care.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean delivery for suspected PAS was more common in women with milder grades of PAS or those with a false positive diagnosis.
